intro.h2: A Wenatchee Remodeling Contractor That Does the Structural Work Too
paragraphs: Upper Left Construction is a licensed remodeling contractor in Wenatchee, and the logo says it plainly: framing, siding, roofing, remodels. The crew handles the parts of a project other remodelers send out, from wall framing to the roof.

That shows in the work they share. On one house they tore out rotten siding and an old patio door, framed in a new living room window and closed it all up with fresh siding. They have built pole shops with lean-to covers, metal roofs over patios and carports, and cedar fences on pressure-treated posts. Reviewers call the quality excellent and very detailed.

items.name: Interior remodels and flooring
items.blurb: Room remodels from the subfloor up, including new flooring for outdated rooms. Their social profile also lists kitchen remodeling, countertops and backsplash. Ask about your room when you call, and they can walk you through what the job involves.

image.alt: Empty room with new windows and bare subfloor prepared for new flooring

items.name: Siding and window changes
items.blurb: Rotten siding removed and replaced, old patio doors taken out and new windows framed in. On one recent house the crew added a living room window and buttoned the outside back up with new siding so it looked like it had always been there.

image.alt: Single-story white lap siding house with green trim and shutters, a covered entry and a green roof

items.name: Roofing, patio covers and carports
items.blurb: Patio covers, carports and flat roofs, plus standing-seam metal roofing. One of their posts calls a patio cover, carport or flat roof no problem, and the photos show a finished metal roof with clean seams and flashing around the vent.

image.alt: Close view of a dark standing-seam metal roof with a flashed vent pipe

items.name: Shops, garages and storage buildings
items.blurb: Extra space for trucks, toys and storage. The crew builds pole buildings with roll-up doors, lean-to covers and man doors, framed and sided to match the property. Message them about the size of building you have in mind.

image.alt: Brown metal-sided shop building with a white roll-up door, open bay and man door

items.name: Fences and decks
items.blurb: Fallen fences replaced with dog-eared cedar pickets on pressure-treated lumber, and low backyard decks with wide steps. They have also posted about building pet spaces, so if the dog needs its own area, ask about that too.

image.alt: New dog-eared cedar privacy fence beside a flower bed with red roses

items.name: Framing and new builds
items.blurb: Wall framing, floor systems and full new builds. Their photos include a two-story home with board-and-batten siding and an attached two-car garage set among the pines, and a large framed floor and walls still under construction.

image.alt: Wood-framed walls and floor joists of a building under construction with trees behind

items.title: Licensed in Washington
items.text: Upper Left Construction lists its Washington contractor licence as UPPERLC801B1. You can look it up with the state before you hire, which every homeowner should do.

items.title: Structure, not just finishes
items.text: Framing, siding and roofing are part of the trade here, so problems found behind a wall or under a roof can be fixed by the same crew.

items.title: Detailed work
items.text: Reviewers describe the work as excellent quality and very detailed, and say this is a company that works hard and will get the job done.

items.title: Big and small jobs
items.text: The same team has built shops and a two-story home, and also replaced a single fence line or added one window. The scope is up to you.

about.text: Upper Left Construction is a Wenatchee contractor working out of 125 N Wilson St. The date on the logo is 2018, and the business holds Washington licence UPPERLC801B1. The logo sums up the trade: framing, siding, roofing and remodels. The work they share fits the area, with pole shops and garages, metal roofs, cedar fences and homes set among the pines, and inside the crew handles remodels and flooring. On its Facebook page the team says it is here to handle any and all of your upcoming projects.

image.alt: Brown and black pole building with a green metal roof, lean-to cover and white man door among tall pines

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (509) 670-2392 or message the Facebook page with photos and a short description of the project you have in mind.

steps.title: Site visit and price
steps.text: The crew looks at the site, checks what is behind the siding or under the roof, and prices the work agreed.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Framing, siding, roofing or interior work is carried out. On past jobs the crew has posted progress photos and promised updated pictures when complete.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: You walk the finished project together and confirm everything is done as agreed before the job is closed out.

items.text: Great quality of work. Excellent company that works hard and will get the job done.

service_area.text: Upper Left Construction is based at 125 N Wilson St in Wenatchee, Washington. The projects they share range from in-town houses with lawns and fences to shops and homes set in the trees outside town. If you are in or near Wenatchee, call or message to check whether your project is a fit and when the crew could get to it.

items.a: Yes. Upper Left Construction lists Washington contractor licence UPPERLC801B1. Homeowners can check any contractor's licence and bond status with Washington Labor and Industries before signing, and it is a good habit for any project, large or small. Ask the crew for a copy of their insurance certificate when you get your price.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Framing, siding, roofing and remodels, as the logo says. That includes interior remodels and flooring, siding and window changes, patio covers, carports and metal roofs, pole shops and storage buildings, cedar fences, decks and new builds. If your project fits under one of those, call and describe it.

Google lists Upper Left Construction as open 24 hours, every day. The quickest way to start is to call (509) 670-2392 or send a message on Facebook with a few photos of the area and a short note about what you want done. Leave your address so they can plan a visit.

items.q: Can you build a shop or garage?
items.a: Yes. Their photos include several pole buildings with roll-up doors, lean-to covers and man doors, and they have posted about building added space and storage for toys and vehicles. Bring your rough size, door needs and site location to the first call so they can talk through options.

Upper Left Construction is at 125 N Wilson St, Wenatchee, WA 98801. They work on homes and properties in and around Wenatchee. Call ahead before stopping by, since the crew spends most of the day out on job sites rather than in the office.

final_cta.text: Call or message Upper Left Construction about your remodel, siding, roof or new building.
